LESSON: WEATHER AND SKY ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and
Topic 1.1: Weather and Sky its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Weather and Sky its resources. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. develop curiosity in appearance of the sky during the observing appearance of day and at night the sky for enjoyment computer games on the Sun moon, clouds and stars

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. develop curiosity in appearance of the sky during the observing appearance of day and at night the sky for enjoyment computer games on the Sun moon, clouds and stars
   In simple words: practise until you can develop curiosity in appearance of the sky during the observing appearance of day and at night the sky for enjoyment computer games on the Sun moon, clouds and stars. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Weather and Sky its resources using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Weather and Sky its resources in the examples.
2. Explain Weather and Sky its resources to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Weather and Sky its resources.
4. Show that you can: develop curiosity in appearance of the sky during the observing appearance of day and at night the sky for enjoyment computer games on the Sun moon, clouds and stars

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weather and Sky its resources using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Weather and Sky its resources important for a Grade 1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Play educative computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars
2. Draw and colour the Sun, moon, clouds and stars.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. develop curiosity in appearance of the sky during the observing appearance of day and at night the sky for enjoyment computer games on the Sun moon, clouds and stars
